title: Bounded coherent image for proper morphisms over a Noetherian base
statement: Let T be a Noetherian scheme and p:Y→T proper [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Supply independent derived localizations on Y and T [def-pc-derived-category]. If A∈D(O_Y) has bounded coherent cohomology [pqf-def-coherent], then Rp_*A [def-pc-derived-direct-image] has bounded coherent cohomology on T. No relative flatness, finite Tor dimension, finite-free representative or pseudo-coherence conclusion is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Tag 08E2, Lemma 36.11.3, specialized to proper p; Tag 02O5 for proper coherence and Tag 08D5 for the uniform upper bound

proof.text: Properness and the Noetherian base make Y Noetherian. Use the bounded-below hypercohomology spectral sequence for the left exact pushforward functor and the supplied bounded source. Its E2 terms are the higher direct images of coherent cohomology sheaves of A, hence coherent by proper coherence. Each total degree has a finite filtration of subquotients of these terms. On a Noetherian scheme coherence is closed under subquotients and finite extensions, so every image cohomology sheaf is coherent. The lower bound is inherited from the lower bound of A and left exactness.

Properness makes p quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and the Noetherian T is quasi-compact. Source coherent cohomology is quasi-coherent. Choose an upper bound b for source cohomology; A[b] has no positive cohomology. The uniform derived-direct-image truncation bound gives N with image cohomology of A[b] zero in degrees at least N. Derived image commutes with shifts, so image cohomology of A vanishes in degrees at least b+N. Combine with the lower bound of step 1. Empty Y and zero A give zero image. No arbitrary-base approximation, flatness, Tor bound or pseudo-coherent representative occurs.
